evidence_items.normalized_text: Enjoys working closely with a team
Prefers working alone without a team

acceptable_outputs: groups both evidence items under one work_preference claim and marks is_contradictory=true
the resulting claim's confidence is clearly lower than either individual evidence item's confidence
unacceptable_outputs: silently picks one side (team or solo) and drops the other evidence item entirely
averages the two into a confident, unflagged 'flexible, works well both ways' claim -- this hides a real contradiction instead of surfacing it
creates two unrelated claims that don't reference each other, losing the fact that they conflict
reviewer_notes: Directly tests Stage 2 brief section 7: contradictions must never be silently averaged away. The claim_synthesis.compute_claim_confidence deterministic formula halves the weakest evidence confidence and forces status=CONTRADICTED whenever is_contradictory=true.

provenance.notes: Invented for Stage 2 golden-dataset coverage; no real candidate involved.
